== Editing ==
Maps a set name or icon key to the printed expansion symbol at 20px plus the set name, both linked. Used by [[Template:Card]] when <code>set_icon</code> is empty (lookup from <code>set</code>) or when <code>set_icon</code> is a short key.

Premiere-family printings with no expansion symbol render '''None ([[Premiere|Premiere]])'''. Mixed products (Reflections II/III exclusives vs reprints, Anthology previews, ESB Two-Player, promotional foils) pass a per-card key. AI Episode I cards use the gold-ring keys <code>Coruscant AI</code>, <code>Tatooine AI</code>, <code>Theed Palace AI</code>.

Unknown values pass through unchanged.
